command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('AGG_SW_01','AGG_SW_02','AGG_SW_03','AGG_SW_04','ChinaUnicom_SW','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','PE1','PE2','PE3','SH_AR','SH_Core','SW-DMZ-ACC-01','SZ_AR','SZ_Core'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){`$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$u0='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$a=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1; `$b=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u0; `$la=`$a.output -split '\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration'}; `$lb=`$b.output -split '\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration'}; `$d=Compare-Object `$lb `$la; if(`$d){'### '+`$n; `$d | ForEach-Object {`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject}}}"
